periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique vertical orientation with the superior poles tilted medially toward the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical axis approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, resulting in a teardrop-like geometry with the mass concentrated in the superior portion.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped profile at the inferior margin of the dark transverse band on the chest.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, occupying roughly 35% of the visible torso length between the neck and the mid-abdomen.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the inter-pinnular gap approximately equal to the total width of the cranial vault.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible upper dentition (incisors and canines) due to open-mouth posture; distinct brownish/rufous discoloration of the ventral pelage.
